title: KS27: U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors arrive at Tsuiki Air Base
description: U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors assigned to the 525th Expeditionary Fighter Squadron, deployed from Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, and a C-130J Super Hercules assigned to the 36th Airlift Squadron arrive at Tsuiki Air Base, Japan, Oct. 19, 2026, in support of Exercise Keen Sword 27 (KS27). The B-roll footage captures aircraft arrivals and airlift operations supporting the exercise. The C-130J delivered equipment to support the 525th Expeditionary Aircraft Maintenance Unit, enabling sustained F-22 Raptor flight operations. KS27 is a routine, biennial bilateral field training exercise with multinational participation, designed to increase readiness and interoperability between the U.S. military and Japan Self-Defense Forces while strengthening the ironclad U.S.-Japan Alliance. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Francisco Huerta)
